description:
Price a batch of documents BEFORE submitting it (#788). No side effect: nothing is stored, charged, or counted against the free tier.

A document costs ceil(pages x the task type's credits_per_page x its line-item multiplier), at least one credit; the multiplier applies when the task type declares a line-item table. The submit charges with the same function, so charged_credits is what the batch costs when every document succeeds and it is submitted in this order this month. A document HandInLoop fails to process (system_error, including after its retries) costs nothing.

Args:
  - task_type: a task type id from handinloop_list_task_types, OR
  - fields: custom inline fields (priced as a custom extraction). Provide task_type OR fields.
  - documents: 1..500, each exactly one of:
      pages (your own page count — cheapest, sends no file),
      document_base64 (the API counts the pages), or
      document_url (fetched here, then counted by the API).
    At most 25 documents may be files (base64 or URL); give pages for the rest.
    file_name is optional on each.

Returns: { task_type, line_items, rate: { credits_per_page, line_item_multiplier }, documents: [{ index, file_name?, pages, credits, free, error? }], pages, credits, free_documents, charged_credits, available_credits, covered, held, spend: { spent_this_month, cap, overage, overage_credits, blocked }, refused? }. covered false or spend.blocked true means the submit would be refused (402); held true means the organisation's billing is on hold for HandInLoop to resolve, and buying credits does not lift it. A file the API could not read is listed under refused, with why, and left out of the totals.

pages.description: Your own page count; sends no file

fields.description: Custom extraction fields. Provide task_type OR fields.

task_type.description: Task type id, e.g. 'invoice'. Provide this OR fields.
